Pendahuluan                                          Introduction

Kami telah mereviu laporan keuangan interim     We have  reviewed  the  accompanying  interim
PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (“Bank”)        financial statements of PT Bank Syariah Indonesia

keuangan interim tanggal 31 Maret 2026, serta       interim statement of financial position as of March
laporan laba rugi dan penghasilan komprehensif      31, 2026, and the interim statement of profit or
lain, laporan perubahan ekuitas, laporan arus kas,        loss and other comprehensive income, statement
laporan rekonsiliasi pendapatan dan bagi hasil,       of changes in equity, statement of cash flows,
laporan sumber dan penyaluran dana zakat, dan       statement of reconciliation of income and revenue
laporan sumber dan penggunaan dana kebajikan       sharing, statement of sources and distribution of

keuangan interim, termasuk informasi kebijakan       then ended, and notes to the interim financial
akuntansi  material.  Manajemen  bertanggung       statements, including material accounting policy
jawab  atas penyusunan dan  penyajian  wajar       information. Management  is responsible for the
laporan keuangan  interim  ini  sesuai  dengan       preparation and fair presentation of this interim
Standar  Akuntansi  Keuangan   di  Indonesia.        financial statements in accordance with Indonesian
Tanggung jawab kami adalah untuk menyatakan        Financial Accounting Standards. Our responsibility

ini berdasarkan reviu kami.                           statements based on our review.

Ruang lingkup reviu                             Scope of review

Kami  melaksanakan  reviu  kami  berdasarkan     We conducted our review  in accordance with
Standar  Perikatan  Reviu  2410,  “Reviu  atas       Standards on Review Engagements 2410, “Review
Informasi Keuangan Interim yang Dilaksanakan       of Interim Financial Information Performed by the
oleh Auditor Independen Entitas” (“SPR 2410”),       Independent Auditor of the Entity (“SPR 2410”)
yang  ditetapkan  oleh  Institut Akuntan  Publik       established by the Indonesian Institute of Certified
Indonesia. Suatu reviu atas informasi keuangan       Public Accountants. A review of interim financial
interim   terdiri   dari  pengajuan  pertanyaan,       information consists of making inquiries, primarily
terutama kepada pihak yang bertanggung jawab       of persons responsible for financial and accounting
atas  bidang  keuangan  dan  akuntansi,  serta       matters, and applying analytical and other review
penerapan prosedur analitis dan prosedur reviu       procedures.
lainnya.
